newsitem.title: USA: Columbia Gas, Washington Gas form alliance. [CORRECTED 22:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Columbia Gas, Washington Gas form alliance. [CORRECTED 22:57 GMT]

text.p: Columbia Gas System Inc and Washington Gas said Tuesday they have formed an alliance to serve large and mid-sized energy consumers in Maryland.

The pact between Columbia Energy Services, the natural gas marketing subsidiary of Columbia Gas, and the natural gas subsidiary of Washington Gas will target industrial and commercial customers, the companies said in a joint release.
"We are capitalizing on the strengths of two strong natural gas marketers to provide customers with cost savings, reliability and delivery performance that will be unmatched," Washington Gas said.

Washington Gas, the parent of Washington Gas Energy Services said it serves more than 770,000 homes and businesses in the Washington, D.C., area (corrects to show that it is the parent and not its subsidiary that serves the 770,000 homes and businesses).
Columbia Energy Services said it provides gas, fuel management and home services to utility companies, industrial plants, residences and businesses.
